req.title: Task update rejects id changes
req.statement: The system shall ignore any id field in the PUT body and only mutate the task addressed by the URL.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the task update endpoint should ignore any changes to the task ID in the request body and only update the task identified by the URL. This ensures data integrity by preventing accidental or malicious changes to task identifiers. The test suite includes positive, negative, and boundary cases to ensure comprehensive coverage of this behavior.

tests.name: test_update_task_ignore_id_change_positive
preconditions: Task with ID 1 exists in the database.
actions: Send a PUT request to update task with ID 1, including a different ID in the request body.
expected: The task with ID 1 is updated successfully.
The task ID in the response remains 1.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.put(
    "/tasks/1",
    json={"id": 999, "title": "Updated Title", "completed": false}
)

assert response.status_code == 200
assert response.json()["id"] == 1
assert response.json()["title"] == "Updated Title"
assert response.json()["completed"] is False

tests.name: test_update_task_ignore_id_change_negative
preconditions: Task with ID 999 does not exist in the database.
actions: Send a PUT request to update task with ID 999, including a different ID in the request body.
expected: The response contains an error message indicating the task was not found.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.put(
    "/tasks/999",
    json={"id": 1, "title": "Non-existent Task", "completed": true}
)

assert response.status_code == 404
assert "Task with id 999 not found" in response.json()["detail"]

tests.name: test_update_task_ignore_id_change_boundary
preconditions: Task with ID 20 exists in the database.
actions: Send a PUT request to update task with ID 20, including a different ID in the request body.
expected: The task with ID 20 is updated successfully.
The task ID in the response remains 20.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.put(
    "/tasks/20",
    json={"id": 0, "title": "Boundary Task Update", "completed": true}
)

assert response.status_code == 200
assert response.json()["id"] == 20
assert response.json()["title"] == "Boundary Task Update"
assert response.json()["completed"] is True
